verdict.rationale: Skyfire exposes a broad reference API (create/charge/introspect tokens, wallet balance, source-IP config, org seller-agent creation) and an MCP server mirroring core commerce actions, showing strong but not total UI/API parity. However, some flows like 'Create Service' and identity-verification subscription purchase are documented only as dashboard clicks, and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (404s on standard paths), so full parity isn't demonstrated. missing for 10: documented API endpoint for creating/approving seller services, machine-readable API spec confirming full coverage, evidence that all dashboard admin actions (org management, verification subscriptions) are API-accessible.
